title.en: ALLIED HEALTH PROFESSIONS OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM AMENDMENT ORDER 2017(1)

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-91_2017_E-ALLIED-HEALTH-PROFESSIONS-OF-BRUNEI-DARUSSALAM-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2017(1).pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Allied Health Professions of Brunei Darussalam (Amendment) Order, 2017 and shall commence on the same date as the Allied Health Professions of Brunei Darussalam Order, 2017. Amendment of section 5 of S 1012017
